# Datascope

DataScope is the ideal tool to get rid of paperwork, save time and collect data efficiently from the field. The platform allows your team to answer personalized mobile forms (even offline), from their phones or tablets.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/datascope/.

## Actions

- **Create Location**: Create a new location in DataScope with geographic coordinates.
- **Get All Answers V2** (read-only): Retrieve last answers from Datascope forms (limit 200 per request).
- **Get All Answers With Metadata** (read-only): Retrieve all answers with metadata from the DataScope platform.
- **Get all list elements** (read-only): Retrieve all items from a specific metadata list in Datascope.
- **Get All Locations** (read-only): Retrieve all locations configured in the DataScope system.
- **Get Last Tickets** (read-only): Retrieve the last 5 tickets (findings) from the DataScope system.
- **Get Ticket Types** (read-only): Retrieve available ticket types (findings types) from the DataScope system.
- **List Last Generated Files** (read-only): Retrieve all generated files (PDFs, Excel) from a specific date range.
- **Get List Element** (read-only): Retrieve a specific element from a metadata list by type and ID.
